thread:
emma: FYI Raj's birthday is Wed 5/18 and he's mostly remote (India). Thinking: small Slack surprise + either a shared lunch for in-office folks or a donation to his favorite charity. Ideas? :confetti_ball:
tyler: Love the slack surprise + donation idea. shipping food internationally is messy.
nina: Agree on donation. Maybe also arrange a local treat for him in India? anyone know good vendors there?
chris: i can DM a vendor i used before in BLR. Also happy to do a short 'happy birthday' video compilation. 10-15s clips from everyone.
emma: sweet. poll: react :moneybag: for donation, :bento: for lunch delivery in India, :cake: for sending a cake box to our SF office and having a mini gathering for those onsite.
people-ops-bot: Tip: For international orders, contact people-ops at least 5 business days prior so we can handle customs/vendor onboarding.
kitchen-bot: Office plan: if :cake: wins, we have fridge space and plates. please log bakery reimbursement in Spend Requests.
tyler: timezone question — what time would we do a short video call so remote folks can join? Raj is IST (GMT+5:30).
emma: thinking 18:30 IST / 09:00 PT might work? that is lunchtime for SF folks. open to alternatives.
nina: 18:30 IST works for me. I'll note it on calendar if we confirm.
chris: i've started a private Google folder for video clips. i'll paste the upload link soon. pls keep clips <20s and say your name at the start.
emma: please drop one-liners for the digital card here so i can compile it — i'll format into a PDF.
tyler: "Happy birthday Raj! Thanks for keeping standards high  and our builds green. :)"
nina: "Hope you get the perfect chai and a day off to enjoy it!"
emma: plan: charity donation currently leading, chris to handle video montage, calendar invite tentatively Wed 18:30 IST / 09:00 PT, people-ops will coordinate donation paperwork if we go that route. final decision by EOD Tue. :tada:
